title: Lower weight decay (0.2 → 0.1)
description: Reduced weight decay magnitude to test if over-regularization limits convergence in 5-minute budget
reflection: Regressed 0.09% (0.995700 → 0.996608). Hypothesis was wrong: the baseline weight decay at 0.2 is optimal, not over-constraining. Lower regularization destabilizes or allows overfitting. This closes the weight decay direction as a productive lever. The binding constraint is not regularization; must explore other dimensions (batch size, embedding initialization, or accept the baseline is near a sharp local maximum).
